learning_objective: The learner will identify the six parts of the publishing pipeline from a description of how each looks, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
specification:
Type: infographic **sim-id:** publishing-pipeline-poster
**Library:** html
**Status:** Specified
**Bloom Level:** Remember
**Bloom Verb:** identify
**Learning Objective:** The learner will identify the six parts of the publishing pipeline from a description of how each looks, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt. **Prerequisites:** Publishing OER, Static Site Generator, MkDocs, GitHub Pages, OER Clearinghouse (all defined in this chapter above this block). **Evidence of Mastery:** In quiz mode the learner clicks the marker that matches a visual hint. A click is correct when it matches the marker named in the Hint column of Content. Mastery is at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt. Hovering in explore mode is exploration, not evidence. **Misconceptions:** (1) The source files and the built site are the same thing. (2) A clearinghouse stores the resource. (3) Deploying and building are the same step. **Instructional Rationale:** Identifying the parts of a pipeline is a Remember-level task, and a left-to-right picture of the whole path gives each part a place. The quiz asks the learner to recognize a part by its look. **Content:** The illustration is a text-free flat drawing read from left to right. At the left is a folder of plain text pages. An arrow leads to a gear. Another arrow leads from the gear to a folder of web pages with a frame around each. Next is a box with a branching line inside it. Beyond it is a globe on a stand. Above the globe, a separate card in a filing drawer points down to the globe with a thin line. The six markers: | # | Label | Hint (describes the look, not the name) | Description | Tip | |---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | Source files | The folder of plain text pages at the left. | The Markdown pages and settings that you write and edit. | Keep the source in version control. | | 2 | Build | The gear between the two folders. | A static site generator, like MkDocs, turns the source into web pages. | Run the strict build first. | | 3 | Built site | The folder of web pages with a frame around each. | The finished pages that a browser can show. | Do not edit these by hand. | | 4 | Repository | The box with the branching line inside it. | The public home of the files, with their history. | Make the repository public and add the license. | | 5 | Hosting | The globe on a stand. | A hosting service like GitHub Pages serves the built site at a public address. | Share the stable address. | | 6 | Clearinghouse listing | The card in the filing drawer with a thin line to the globe. | A catalog entry that points to the published site. | The listing links to your site, and your site stays the source. | **Provenance:** The six parts follow the chapter sections "Publishing OER", "Static Site Generator", "MkDocs", "GitHub Pages", and "OER Clearinghouse". The illustration is synthetic, and the sim labels it "illustrative example". **Rules:** Each hint matches exactly one marker. The illustration contains no text, so every label comes from the table above. Markers are numbered 1 to 6 from left to right. **Learner Activity:** 1. In explore mode the learner hovers or clicks a marker and reads its label, description, and tip. 2. In quiz mode the sim shows a hint. 3. The learner clicks the marker they think the hint describes. 4. If the first click is wrong, the sim says so and lets the learner try once more. If the second click is also wrong, the sim reveals the marker and its description. 5. After all 6 hints the sim shows the summary. **Feedback:** 6 hints in a shuffled order, two attempts each. Only a correct first click counts as evidence. Correct: "Correct: [label]. [Description]". First wrong click: "Not quite. Look again at the hint: [hint]". Second wrong click: "This is [label]. [Description]". The summary shows "[n] of 6 correct on the first attempt". At 5 or more it adds "You can follow the path to publication." Below 5 it lists the labels of the missed parts. **Starting State:** The illustration with six numbered markers, explore mode active, and the prompt "Hover a marker to see a part of the pipeline." **Chapter Anchors:** The chapter's eight publishing steps and its sections on the generator, MkDocs, GitHub Pages, and the clearinghouse describe these six parts.
